title: VUL-001 SQL injection in login and product search
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and bind parameters

title: VUL-002 Potential SSRF in profile image upload
remediation: Validate destinations and block private network access

title: VUL-003 Weak password hashing and embedded JWT key material
remediation: Use Argon2id for passwords and securely manage signing keys

title: VUL-004 Dynamic evaluation of profile data
remediation: Remove eval and treat user input as data

title: VUL-005 Weak redirect URL validation
remediation: Validate parsed URL origins against an explicit allowlist

title: VUL-006 Potential application log disclosure
remediation: Restrict log access and redact sensitive information

title: VUL-007 Incomplete browser security controls
remediation: Implement appropriate CSP and verify security headers

title: VUL-008 Training configuration and backup exposure risk
remediation: Restrict training features to isolated environments and protect backups
